title: Storefront checkout and order capture
notes: The control case for the exemplar-domain-bias delta (ticket 009 decision 6). Deliberately near-identical in shape to analyst.md's shared exemplar system: three network zones, an internet-facing API in a DMZ, a core worker, a PII/financial datastore with unverified at-rest protection, an append-only-ish archive, and an unauthenticated third-party payment callback. It is not a copy — names, technologies and flow labels differ — but nothing structural is far from the exemplar, which is the point: far-domain recall is only meaningful as a delta against this.
